num1, num2, max_den = map(int, input().split())

def find_gcd(a, b):
    while b != 0:
        a, b = b, a % b
    return a

g = find_gcd(num1, num2)
num1 //= g
num2 //= g

if max_den >= num2:
    print(f"{num1}/{num2}")
else:
    ratio = num1 / num2
    closest_diff = ratio
    numerator = 0
    denominator = 1
    for i in range(1, max_den + 1):
        candidate = i * ratio
        lower = int(candidate)
        diff_lower = abs(lower / i - ratio)
        diff_upper = abs((lower + 1) / i - ratio)
        if closest_diff > diff_lower or closest_diff > diff_upper:
            if diff_lower > diff_upper:
                numerator = lower + 1
            else:
                numerator = lower
            denominator = i
            closest_diff = min(diff_lower, diff_upper)
    print(f"{numerator}/{denominator}")
